name: @blueshed/delta
description: delta: documents people share, kept live over one WebSocket with JSON Patch; stored in a JSON file or SQLite (Postgres is dzql)

scripts.prepare: bun -e "import { cpSync, existsSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; const from = ['../railroad', 'node_modules/@blueshed/railroad'].map((p) => p + '/.claude/skills/railroad').find((p) => existsSync(p)); if (from) { rmSync('.claude/skills/railroad', { recursive: true, force: true }); cpSync(from, '.claude/skills/railroad', { recursive: true }); }"
scripts.test:fast: bun check && bun check -p examples/kanban && DELTA_LAW_SEEDS=1 DELTA_LAW_STEPS=50 bun test tests/
scripts.test:slow: bun check && bun check -p examples/kanban && bun test tests/

author: Peter Bunyan <peter@blueshed.co.uk> (https://blueshed.co.uk)
